1. There is an excessive amount of bird droppings accumulating in the sheep barn. This material is located in an area
where the goats can reach. Bird droppings may contain disease causing agents and can negatively affect the health of
the animals. The facility must ensure that animal areas are kept clean and maintained in good repair.
2. The door for the sheep barn was found with jagged edges at the bottom of the wooden boards. This could lead to
excessive drafts which may affect the animals. Animal facilities must be kept in good repair. These items must be
corrected by the facility.
